name: @saas-inventory/pg-verify
description: PROMPT 03-A verification-only tool: runs a real, local, Docker-free PostgreSQL instance (embedded-postgres) to verify migrations/RLS/roles/multi-tenancy against a genuine PostgreSQL server. Not part of the application runtime or docker-compose.dev.yml's deployment infra. Deliberately has NO dependency on drizzle-orm — it only issues raw SQL via the `postgres` driver and shells out to the real pnpm scripts — so it never shares dependency resolution with apps/api's or database's Drizzle schema.
